aspect.ccextras.assassine.desc: When you defeat an enemy, there is a 1% - 5% chance that your critical hit damage is increased by 5% - 10% for the next 3- 8 seconds.
aspect.ccextras.ausbruchs.desc: When you land a killing blow on an enemy affected by poison or wither, there is an 80% - 100% chance that the effect jumps to 5 - 10 enemies within 10 - 30 blocks and deals 10% - 25% of your base damage over 3 - 8 seconds.
aspect.ccextras.axt.desc: Attacks with an axe deal 3% - 10% more damage.
aspect.ccextras.bergs.desc: Each of your attacks has a 7% - 15% chance to increase your armor by 1% - 5% for 10 - 20 seconds. The effect stacks up to 2 - 5 times.
aspect.ccextras.bezwingers.desc: Your attacks deal 5% - 15% more damage to boss enemies.
aspect.ccextras.blitzes.desc: Your attacks have a 3% - 10% chance to strike enemies within 2 - 8 blocks with lightning, dealing 5% - 10% of your general damage and stunning them with a 30% - 50% chance for 1 - 3 seconds.
aspect.ccextras.blitzfokus.desc: Your attacks have a 1% - 3% chance to increase your dodge chance by 1% - 3% for 3 - 10 seconds. The effect stacks up to 2 - 5 times.
aspect.ccextras.blutfessel.desc: Your attacks have a 10% - 20% chance to stun enemies affected by a bleeding effect for 3 - 5 seconds.
aspect.ccextras.eitelkeit.desc: Your attacks deal 3% - 8% more damage as long as you have a shield.
aspect.ccextras.flamme.desc: Your attacks have a 10% - 25% chance to set the enemy on fire for 3 - 7 seconds, dealing 5% - 10% of your base damage.
aspect.ccextras.flinken_wut.desc: Each defeated enemy increases your attack speed by 1% - 3% for 3 - 10 seconds. The effect stacks up to 2 - 5 times.
aspect.ccextras.flinkheit.desc: Your attacks increase your movement speed by 1% - 3% per hit; this effect stacks up to 2 - 5 times.
aspect.ccextras.forschers.desc: Every time you defeat an enemy, there is a 1% - 5% chance that your currently running research is reduced by 1 - 2 seconds.
aspect.ccextras.gelehrten.desc: When you defeat an enemy, there is a 1% - 5% chance that your experience gained is increased by 3% - 10% for the next 2 - 7 seconds.
aspect.ccextras.gier.desc: Your attacks have a 10% - 20% chance to increase your coin chance by 5% - 10% for 10 - 20 seconds.
aspect.ccextras.giftes.desc: Your attacks have a 10% - 25% chance to poison the enemy for 3 - 7 seconds, dealing 5% - 10% of your base damage.
aspect.ccextras.gluecks.desc: When you defeat an enemy, there is a 1% - 5% chance that your luck level is increased by 1 - 5 for the next 3 - 8 seconds.
aspect.ccextras.gravitation.desc: Your attacks have a 2% - 12% chance to pull enemies within X blocks towards you.
aspect.ccextras.hast.desc: Your critical hits have a 1% - 5% chance to increase your attack speed by 5% - 10% for 3 - 7 seconds.
aspect.ccextras.heiligenlichts.desc: Your attacks deal 10% - 20% more damage to undead.
aspect.ccextras.heilung.desc: Every time an aspect triggers, there is a 3% - 7% chance that you are healed by (x)% of your maximum health.
aspect.ccextras.hinrichtung.desc: You deal 10% - 25% more damage to enemies below 50% health.
aspect.ccextras.inneren_ruhe.desc: Your attacks deal 5% - 10% more damage for 5 - 10 seconds as long as you stand still.
aspect.ccextras.kaktus.desc: When you defeat an enemy, there is a 1% - 3% chance that you generate cactus equal to 1% - 5% of your maximum cactus.
aspect.ccextras.kaktusmeister.desc: Your attacks have a 0% - 1% chance to generate cactus equal to 2% - 5% of your maximum cacti.
aspect.ccextras.kaskade.desc: Your attacks have a 3% - 10% chance to jump to enemies within 5 - 12 blocks; each jump reduces the attack's damage by 20% - 50%.
aspect.ccextras.kontrolle.desc: Your attacks deal 5% - 15% more damage to immobilized, frozen or stunned enemies.
aspect.ccextras.kriegers.desc: Attacks with a sword or an axe have a 1% - 3% chance to increase your strength by 3% - 10% for 3 - 8 seconds.
aspect.ccextras.kriegers.desc2: Attacks with a sword or an axe have a 1% - 3% chance to increase your strength by 3% - 10%.
aspect.ccextras.kaelte.desc: Your attacks have a 1% - 5% chance to freeze enemies for 1 - 3 seconds.
aspect.ccextras.meisterschaft.desc: Your attacks have a 1% - 5% chance to increase your critical hit chance by 1% - 4% for 3 - 7 seconds. The effect stacks 1 - 3 times.
aspect.ccextras.meteors.desc: Your attacks have a 3% - 10% chance to drop a meteor on a random enemy within 5 - 12 blocks, dealing 10% - 20% of your general damage within 3 - 5 blocks.
aspect.ccextras.mondes.desc: Your attacks increase your attack speed by 1% - 3% for 3 - 5 seconds, stackable up to 2 - 5 times. At maximum stacks you enter a vampire frenzy for 3 - 10 seconds that increases your damage by 3% - 10% and grants 3% - 10% more movement speed.
aspect.ccextras.muenze.desc: When you defeat an enemy, there is a 1% - 5% chance that the coins it drops are increased by 5% - 12%.
aspect.ccextras.opferung.desc: When you defeat an enemy affected by a bleeding effect, there is a 10% - 15% chance that you heal yourself by 5% - 10%.
aspect.ccextras.pyrolyse.desc: Your attacks have an 80% - 100% chance, on a killing blow, to make enemies with a burning effect explode, dealing 30% - 50% of their maximum health as damage within 2 - 6 blocks.
aspect.ccextras.raserei.desc: After every 3 - 8 defeated enemies, your attack speed is increased by 5% - 10% for 3 - 5 seconds.
aspect.ccextras.reichtums.desc: Your attacks have a 10% - 20% chance to increase your coin amount by 5% - 10% for 10 - 20 seconds.
aspect.ccextras.schlaechters.desc: Your attacks have a 1% - 5% chance to make the enemy bleed for 3 - 7 seconds, dealing 5% - 10% of your general damage.
aspect.ccextras.schmieds.desc: Every time you defeat an enemy, there is a 1% - 5% chance that 20 - 50 speed is added to the current production in the anvil.
aspect.ccextras.schnitters.desc: Your attacks have a 1% - 3% chance to increase your critical hit damage by 3% - 5% for 3 - 8 seconds. The effect stacks up to 2 - 5 times.
aspect.ccextras.schwertes.desc: Attacks with a sword deal 3% - 10% more damage.
aspect.ccextras.schwaeche.desc: Your attacks have a 1% - 3% chance to deal 3% - 10% more damage based on your general damage, and the enemy's damage is reduced by 3% - 10% for 2 - 7 seconds.
aspect.ccextras.seele.desc: When you defeat an enemy, there is a 1% - 3% chance that you generate souls worth 1% - 5% of your highest wave reached so far.
aspect.ccextras.seelenschnitter.desc: Your attacks have a 0% - 1% chance to generate souls equal to 5% - 10% of your highest wave reached so far.
aspect.ccextras.sturzfluges.desc: Your attacks deal 10% - 20% more damage to flying enemies.
aspect.ccextras.substanz.desc: Your attacks have a 10% - 20% chance to increase your drop chance by 5% - 10% for 10 - 20 seconds.
aspect.ccextras.telekinese.desc: Your attacks have a 5% - 15% chance to teleport you to the nearest enemy within 10 - 30 blocks.
aspect.ccextras.tiefsee.desc: Your attacks deal 10% - 20% more damage to underwater enemies.
aspect.ccextras.titanen.desc: Your attacks have a 1% - 3% chance to deal 3% - 10% more damage to boss enemies.
aspect.ccextras.todeszorn.desc: Your next attack after 3 - 8 defeated enemies deals 10% - 25% more damage.
aspect.ccextras.todsuchers.desc: When you defeat an enemy, there is a 1% - 3% chance that for the next 3 - 8 seconds your critical hit chance is increased by 3% - 8% and your critical hit damage by 5% - 10%.
aspect.ccextras.verdorrenen.desc: Your attacks have a 10% - 25% chance to wither the enemy for 3 - 7 seconds, dealing 5% - 10% of your base damage.
aspect.ccextras.wahrensicht.desc: Every time an aspect triggers, there is a 1% - 5% chance that your critical hit chance is increased by 3% - 10% for 3 - 7 seconds.
aspect.ccextras.windes.desc: Every time an aspect triggers, there is a 20% - 50% chance that your walking speed is increased by 7% - 15% for 10 - 15 seconds.
aspect.ccextras.wirbelwinds.desc: Your attacks have a 3% - 10% chance to trigger a whirlwind attack that deals 30% - 50% of your base damage within 2 - 5 blocks.
aspect.ccextras.wissens.desc: When you defeat an enemy, there is a 1% - 3% chance that the experience gained is increased by 1% - 5%.
